Here we want to create a dataset where each row is a meta-ecosystem. Or an isolated two-patch system, commposed of two isolated patches (e.g., one medium blue and one medium green).

Let's create a data frame with all the experimental meta-ecosystems and all the possible meta-ecosystems from isolated. 

```{r}
ds_patches %>%
    group_by(patch_type) %>%
    summarise(culture_ID_values = list(unique(culture_ID)))
```
